images.caption: Figure 1:Evolution and positioning of interpretability for latent-space world models. Despite rapid advances in latent-space world modeling and a rich XAI toolbox, direct interpretation of learned world models remains sparse. Existing efforts largely focus on latent-content probing or isolated analysis and intervention techniques, leaving systematic understanding of latent worlds underexplored.

header: 3Blueprint: From Decoding to Understanding Latent Worlds

images.caption: Figure 2:From decoding representations to understanding latent worlds. The proposed blueprint progresses through four stages: Ground connects latent factors to interpretable world variables; Structure recovers their relations and dynamics; Verify tests their causal roles through controlled interventions; and Act uses verified understanding to diagnose failures and improve model behavior.

Figure 3:Cross-domain instantiations of latent worlds. Representative JEPA-based models across robot manipulation, 3D localization, medical care, and scientific discovery illustrate how relevant world variables, relations, and dynamics depend on the application domain. Latent-world interpretation therefore requires grounding representations in domain-specific concepts and interactions rather than assuming a universal set of interpretable features.
